name: fragment version
eval: window.BWFX && window.BWFX.version ? window.BWFX.version : (window.BWFX ? 'no version field' : 'NO BWFX')

name: arm ECHO so something is audible in the rack
eval: (function(){ var r = document.querySelector('[data-bwfx-module=echo] .bwfx-rocker') || document.querySelector('.bwfx-rocker'); if (r) r.click(); return r ? 'clicked a rocker' : 'NO ROCKER'; })()

name: before: macro values and the rack's own resolution of mix
eval: (function(){ var d = window.BWFX.debug(); return 'vals ' + JSON.stringify(d.macroVals) + ' | macros ' + JSON.stringify(d.macros) + ' | rack ' + JSON.stringify(d.rack); })()

name: drag RACK MIX to zero
eval: (function(){ var m = document.getElementById('bwfxMix'); m.value = 0; m.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); return 'sent; readout ' + document.getElementById('bwfxMixOut').textContent + ', slider now ' + m.value; })()

name: ask the native side for a fresh state (several audio blocks later)
after: macro 5 fader, values, THE RACK's resolution (base + off = what the audio uses)
eval: (function(){ var d = window.BWFX.debug(); var r = document.querySelectorAll('#bwfxMacros input[type=range]'); return 'macro5 fader ' + r[4].value + ' | vals ' + JSON.stringify(d.macroVals) + ' | rack ' + JSON.stringify(d.rack) + ' | mix slider ' + document.getElementById('bwfxMix').value + ' readout ' + document.getElementById('bwfxMixOut').textContent; })()

name: rack header with the mix at zero
drag RACK MIX back to full
eval: (function(){ var m = document.getElementById('bwfxMix'); m.value = 100; m.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); return 'sent'; })()

name: restored
eval: (function(){ var d = window.BWFX.debug(); var r = document.querySelectorAll('#bwfxMacros input[type=range]'); return 'macro5 fader ' + r[4].value + ' | vals ' + JSON.stringify(d.macroVals) + ' | rack ' + JSON.stringify(d.rack); })()
